# AISLING

> AISLING (said ASH-ling) is a generative Irish ambient instrument: harps and a flute over a held drone, in the old modes. It is free firmware for the M-VAVE FM-1 and the M-VAVE SMK-37 Elite, by CÚ_STE (Stephen Cummins).

- It plays itself from the moment it is switched on, and you can play along. Eight pieces.
- No hardware is needed to try it: the browser emulator runs the same code as the FM-1.
- Four parts: AISLING on the FM-1; AISLING FX-1, which makes an FM-1 a USB effects box for a computer's sound; AISLING on the SMK-37 Elite (the Elite only, not the SMK-37 Pro, on M-VAVE's firmware V016; installed from a computer, with no web installer yet); and VOXBOX, a touch screen kit beside the FM-1.
- Installing other firmware is at your own risk. An FM-1 holds one firmware at a time. The support page covers backing up, switching and recovery.
- GPL-3.0, a fork of NACHTFAHRT, built on Felucca. Not affiliated with M-VAVE.

## AISLING on the FM-1

- [FM-1 page](https://aisling.stephen8n.com/fm1/): what it is and the current release
- [Install](https://aisling.stephen8n.com/install/): from Chrome or Edge on a computer, over a USB data cable
- [Manual](https://aisling.stephen8n.com/manual/): every control, page and piece
- [Controls](https://aisling.stephen8n.com/fm1/controls/): each knob, button and key, drawn
- [Cheat sheet](https://aisling.stephen8n.com/cheat/): the steps as flows, and one page to print
- [Support](https://aisling.stephen8n.com/support/): back up, switch firmware and recover an FM-1 with M-Flasher, a tool by Julius Vitkauskas

## Without an FM-1

- [Emulator](https://aisling.stephen8n.com/emu/): AISLING in the browser, with sound
- [App](https://aisling.stephen8n.com/emu/?app): the emulator as a home-screen app on a phone; tested on an iPhone only
- [Visualiser](https://aisling.stephen8n.com/visualiser/): paints a landscape from what an FM-1 plays, over Web MIDI, or from a demo

## Making and recording

- [Editor](https://aisling.stephen8n.com/editor/): every setting of a piece on one panel, on the emulator or an FM-1 over USB
- [Sound packs](https://aisling.stephen8n.com/packs/): hear a pack in the page, then put it on an FM-1
- [Plug-in](https://aisling.stephen8n.com/plugin/): AISLING's engine as a VST3, Audio Unit and app, for making pack sounds; built from source, no download yet
- [Record into Ableton Live](https://aisling.stephen8n.com/record/): sound, notes, tempo and effects over one USB cable; the page says which steps have been tried
- [Strudel](https://aisling.stephen8n.com/strudel/): play AISLING for VIBE FM from VS Code with strdltn, no FM-1 needed

## AISLING FX-1

- [FX-1 page](https://aisling.stephen8n.com/fx1/): a computer's sound, or a guitar by way of the computer, through AISLING's filter, echo, reverb and effects
- [Install](https://aisling.stephen8n.com/fx1/install/)
- [Manual](https://aisling.stephen8n.com/fx1/manual/)
- [Controls](https://aisling.stephen8n.com/fx1/controls/)

## SMK-37 Elite

- [SMK-37 page](https://aisling.stephen8n.com/smk37/): release, download and what has been checked
- [Manual](https://aisling.stephen8n.com/smk37/manual/)
- [Controls](https://aisling.stephen8n.com/smk37/controls/)

## VOXBOX

- [VOXBOX](https://aisling.stephen8n.com/voxbox/): a 3.5-inch touch screen for the FM-1 that paints what it plays and puts firmware on it from a microSD card; made and tried on one box
- [Lego tray](https://aisling.stephen8n.com/voxbox/tray/): a 50-brick stand for it, built once as a prototype

## Source

- [fm1-aisling](https://github.com/stephencummins/fm1-aisling): the FM-1 firmware and this site
- [fx1-aisling](https://github.com/stephencummins/fx1-aisling): FX-1
- [smk37-aisling](https://github.com/stephencummins/smk37-aisling): the SMK-37 Elite port

## Related

- [Gear](https://gear.stephen8n.com/): what plugs into an FM-1 running AISLING, and how
- [Store](https://store.stephen8n.com/): FM-1 skins, coming soon; checkout is not open
